headline: Jefferson go through conference play without dropping a point
dek: Jefferson's only defeat this season came against a non-conference side in September, and they have won every match since. Across all their matches they have scored 49 goals and conceded 11; only Bridgeport, whom they beat in October, have let in fewer.
